decision_conditions: The proposal would increase the approved occupancy of the House in Multiple Occupation from 8 to 9 residents, resulting in a more intensive form of occupation than that previously assessed and accepted under planning permission ref. 26/01196/FUL. The approved scheme represented a carefully balanced assessment of the scale and intensity of occupation that could be accommodated on the site having regard to the character and function of the property and its location within an established residential area. In the absence of any material change in circumstances, the proposed increase in occupancy is considered to represent an over-intensive form of development that would be out of keeping with the residential character of the area. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policies D3 and D4 of the London Plan (2021), Core Policies CP5 and CP30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), and Policies DMD5, DMD6 and DMD8 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).
